# AFI Conservatory

> > AFI Conservatory is the American Film Institute's graduate film school offering MFA programs and professional workshops in cinematography, directing, screenwriting, and production design.

The conservatory provides hands-on film education through its MFA program, specialized workshops like the Directing Workshop for Women (DWW+), and intensive programs taught by industry professionals including renowned cinematographers Caleb Deschanel and Matthew Libatique. The school emphasizes practical filmmaking experience at the AFI Backlot and prepares students for successful careers in the film industry.

## Key Topics

- MFA Program

## Seminars & Educational Content

- [Exploring Theme Through Genre – Directing Seminar](https://conservatory.afi.com/exploring-theme-through-genre-directing-seminar): Directing seminar exploring theme and genre in filmmaking
- [The Art of Screenwriting: Script to Screen](https://conservatory.afi.com/the-art-of-screenwriting-script-to-screen-at-the-afi): Educational content on screenwriting process from script to screen
- [The Art of Producing: The Power of the Pitch Deck](https://conservatory.afi.com/the-art-of-producing-the-power-of-the-pitch-deck): Educational content on creating effective pitch decks for producers
- [Transitioning from Theater Design to Production Design](https://conservatory.afi.com/similarities-and-opportunities-with-joe-garrity-and-guests): Seminar on theater to production design transition with Joe Garrity
